rows.label: FX and Metals: Spot and Forwards

cells.value:
WITH book AS (
  SELECT bids, asks FROM market_data
  WHERE symbol = @symbol AND timestamp >= dateadd('m', -10, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof
  LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
), m AS (
  SELECT (bids[1][1] + asks[1][1]) / 2 AS mid FROM book
)
SELECT round((u.price - m.mid) / @pip, 1) AS pips_from_mid, u.depth AS bid_depth, NULL::double AS ask_depth
FROM book b CROSS JOIN m, UNNEST(b.bids[1], array_cum_sum(b.bids[2])) u(price, depth)
UNION ALL
SELECT round((u.price - m.mid) / @pip, 1), NULL::double, u.depth
FROM book b CROSS JOIN m, UNNEST(b.asks[1], array_cum_sum(b.asks[2])) u(price, depth)
ORDER BY pips_from_mid
cells.name: Market Depth (pips from mid)

cells.value:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT timestamp, bid_price, bid_volume, symbol, ecn FROM core_price
  WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -1, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
  LIMIT -6
), levels AS (
  SELECT market_data.timestamp AS md_timestamp,
         insertion_point(bids[2], bid_volume) AS level,
         bids[1][insertion_point(bids[2], bid_volume)] AS price,
         bids[2][insertion_point(bids[2], bid_volume)] AS volume,
         p.timestamp, p.bid_price, p.bid_volume AS bid_volume, p.ecn
  FROM p ASOF JOIN market_data ON symbol
)
SELECT to_str(md_timestamp, 'HH:mm:ss.SSS') AS MarketData_Time, CASE WHEN price IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE level END AS Level, price AS Price, volume::long AS Volume,
       to_str(timestamp, 'HH:mm:ss.SSS') AS CorePrice_Time, bid_price AS Bid_Price, bid_volume1 AS Bid_Volume, ecn AS ECN
FROM levels
cells.name: Top-of-book Price vs Core Price

cells.value:
SELECT to_str(ts, 'HH:mm:ss') AS Time, cast(round(spread, 5) AS DECIMAL(18, 5)) AS Spread,
       round(bid_volume)::long AS Bid_Volume, round(ask_volume)::long AS Ask_Volume
FROM (
  SELECT timestamp AS ts, avg(asks[1,1] - bids[1,1]) AS spread, sum(bids[1,1] * bids[2,1]) AS bid_volume, sum(asks[1,1] * asks[2,1]) AS ask_volume
  FROM market_data
  WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('s', -65, @asof) AND timestamp <= dateadd('s', -5, @asof) AND symbol = @symbol
  SAMPLE BY 1s
  ORDER BY ts DESC
  LIMIT 6
)
cells.name: Spread and Volume per second

SELECT timestamp, first(bids[1,1]) AS open, max(bids[1,1]) AS high, min(bids[1,1]) AS low, last(bids[1,1]) AS close
FROM market_data
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -1, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
SAMPLE BY 1s;
SELECT timestamp, sum(bids[2,1]) AS total_volume
FROM market_data
WHERE timestamp >= dateadd('m', -1, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol = @symbol
SAMPLE BY 1s

WITH
  quote_curve AS (
    SELECT tenor, CASE @quote WHEN 'USD' THEN usd WHEN 'EUR' THEN eur WHEN 'JPY' THEN jpy
                              WHEN 'CHF' THEN chf WHEN 'CAD' THEN cad END AS quote_rate
    FROM (
                SELECT 'ON' tenor, 3.88 usd, 2.42 eur, 1.23 jpy, -0.05 chf, 2.24 cad FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT 'TN', 3.88, 2.42, 1.23, -0.05, 2.24 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '1W', 3.88, 2.43, 1.23, -0.04, 2.24 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '2W', 3.89, 2.44, 1.24, -0.04, 2.23 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '1M', 3.90, 2.46, 1.25, -0.03, 2.22 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '2M', 3.92, 2.49, 1.26, -0.02, 2.21 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '3M', 3.93, 2.52, 1.27, -0.01, 2.20 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '6M', 3.95, 2.58, 1.30, 0.01, 2.18 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '9M', 3.95, 2.62, 1.33, 0.03, 2.16 FROM long_sequence(1)
      UNION ALL SELECT '1Y', 3.94, 2.65, 1.35, 0.05, 2.15 FROM long_sequence(1)
    )
  ),
  spot AS (
    SELECT bid_price, ask_price FROM core_price
    WHERE symbol = @symbol AND timestamp <= @asof
    LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
  ),
  curve AS (
    SELECT tenor, tenor_days, value_date, bid_points, ask_points, spot_ref FROM fx_forward_points
    WHERE symbol = @symbol AND timestamp <= @asof
    LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY tenor
  ),
  ladder AS (
    SELECT tenor, tenor_days, value_date, bid_points, ask_points, spot_ref,
      sum(CASE WHEN tenor_days < 0 THEN bid_points END)
        OVER (ORDER BY tenor_days DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_bid,
      sum(CASE WHEN tenor_days < 0 THEN ask_points END)
        OVER (ORDER BY tenor_days DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_ask,
      CASE WHEN tenor_days < 0
           THEN least(lead(tenor_days) OVER (ORDER BY tenor_days), 0) - tenor_days
           ELSE tenor_days END AS days
    FROM curve
  )
SELECT l.tenor AS Tenor, to_str(l.value_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS "Value date", l.bid_points AS "Bid", l.ask_points AS "Ask",
  regexp_replace(cast(cast(round(CASE WHEN l.tenor_days < 0 THEN s.bid_price - l.cum_ask * @pip ELSE s.bid_price + l.bid_points * @pip END, @dp) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS STRING), '\.?0+$', '') AS "Out bid",
  regexp_replace(cast(cast(round(CASE WHEN l.tenor_days < 0 THEN s.ask_price - l.cum_bid * @pip ELSE s.ask_price + l.ask_points * @pip END, @dp) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS STRING), '\.?0+$', '') AS "Out ask",
  cast(round(((1 + q.quote_rate / 100 * l.days / 360)
          / (1 + (l.bid_points + l.ask_points) / 2 * @pip / l.spot_ref) - 1) * @base_basis / l.days * 100, 3) AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) AS "Impl %"
FROM ladder l
JOIN quote_curve q ON q.tenor = l.tenor
CROSS JOIN spot s
ORDER BY l.tenor_days
cells.name: Forward Curve (points in pips)

SELECT timestamp, spot_ref AS spot
FROM fx_forward_points
WHERE symbol = @symbol AND tenor = '3M' AND timestamp >= dateadd('m', -15, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof;
SELECT timestamp, (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 AS "3M points"
FROM fx_forward_points
WHERE symbol = @symbol AND tenor = '3M' AND timestamp >= dateadd('m', -15, @asof) AND timestamp <= @asof
cells.name: 3M Points vs Spot

cells.value:
WITH
  prem AS (
    SELECT timestamp, tenor,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'EURUSD' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 * 0.0001 / spot_ref END) AS eurusd,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'USDJPY' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 * 0.01 / spot_ref END) AS usdjpy,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'XAUUSD' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 * 0.01 / spot_ref END) AS xauusd,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'EURJPY' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 END) AS eurjpy_points,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'EURJPY' THEN spot_ref END) AS eurjpy_spot,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'XAUEUR' THEN (bid_points + ask_points) / 2 END) AS xaueur_points,
      max(CASE WHEN symbol = 'XAUEUR' THEN spot_ref END) AS xaueur_spot,
      max(tenor_days) AS tenor_days
    FROM fx_forward_points_1m
    WHERE timestamp >= @from AND timestamp <= @asof AND symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'USDJPY', 'EURJPY', 'XAUUSD', 'XAUEUR')
    GROUP BY timestamp, tenor
  ),
  complete AS (
    SELECT * FROM prem
    WHERE eurusd IS NOT NULL AND usdjpy IS NOT NULL AND eurjpy_points IS NOT NULL
      AND timestamp < timestamp_floor('m', @asof)
  ),
  latest AS (SELECT max(timestamp) AS ts FROM complete)
SELECT c.tenor AS Tenor,
  round(abs(c.eurjpy_points - c.eurjpy_spot * ((1 + c.eurusd) * (1 + c.usdjpy) - 1) / 0.01), 2) AS EURJPY,
  round(abs(c.xaueur_points - c.xaueur_spot * ((1 + c.xauusd) / (1 + c.eurusd) - 1) / 0.01), 2) AS XAUEUR
FROM complete c CROSS JOIN latest l
WHERE c.timestamp = l.ts
ORDER BY c.tenor_days
cells.name: Triangular Consistency Gap (pips)

cells.value:
WITH
  spot AS (
    SELECT bid_price, ask_price FROM core_price
    WHERE symbol = @symbol AND timestamp <= @asof
    LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY symbol
  ),
  curve AS (
    SELECT tenor, tenor_days, bid_points, ask_points, spot_ref FROM fx_forward_points
    WHERE symbol = @symbol AND timestamp <= @asof
    LATEST ON timestamp PARTITION BY tenor
  )
SELECT 'SPOT' AS Near, c.tenor AS Far, c.tenor_days AS Days,
  c.bid_points AS "Bid swap", c.ask_points AS "Ask swap",
  cast(round((c.bid_points + c.ask_points) / 2 * @pip / c.spot_ref * 360 / c.tenor_days * 100, 3) AS DECIMAL(18, 3)) AS "Implied swap rate %",
  regexp_replace(cast(cast(round(s.bid_price + c.bid_points * @pip, @dp) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS STRING), '\.?0+$', '') AS "Far outright bid",
  regexp_replace(cast(cast(round(s.ask_price + c.ask_points * @pip, @dp) AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS STRING), '\.?0+$', '') AS "Far outright ask"
FROM curve c CROSS JOIN spot s
WHERE c.tenor_days > 0
ORDER BY c.tenor_days
cells.name: Swap Ladder from Spot

variables.name: pip
variables.value: CASE WHEN @symbol LIKE '%JPY' THEN 0.01 WHEN @symbol = 'XAGUSD' THEN 0.001 WHEN @symbol LIKE 'X%' THEN 0.01 ELSE 0.0001 END

variables.name: dp
variables.value: CASE WHEN @symbol LIKE '%JPY' OR @symbol LIKE 'X%' THEN 4 WHEN @symbol = 'XAGUSD' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

variables.name: base_basis
variables.value: CASE WHEN left(@symbol, 3) = 'GBP' THEN 365.0 ELSE 360.0 END
